metadata.source: Income Tax Act 2023, Finance Ordinance 2025, VAT & SD Act 2012
metadata.coverage: Manufacturing, Export-oriented, Financial Services, Real Estate

manufacturing_sector.definition: পণ্য প্রস্তুত বা কোন ধরনের উদ্যোগ (undertaking)

minimum_tax_relief.description: 0.1% of gross receipts for first 3 years of commercial production
minimum_tax_relief.condition: পণ্য উৎপাদনে নিয়োজিত কোনো শিল্প প্রতিষ্ঠানের ক্ষেত্রে ইহার বাণিজ্যিক উৎপাদন শুরুর প্রথম ৩ (তিন) বৎসরের জন্য

utilities.description: Full deduction for manufacturing utilities (electricity, gas, water)

raw_materials.description: Full cost of raw materials and components

input_tax_credit.raw_materials: Full credit available for manufacturing inputs

export_oriented_sector.definition: বাংলাদেশের বাহিরে ভোগের জন্য অভিপ্রেত কোন পণ্য বা সেবা

cash_incentive.note: Cash incentives from government are taxable but export expenses fully deductible

deemed_export.definition: প্রচ্ছন্ন রপ্তানি - domestic supply against foreign currency

zero_rating.direct_exports: 0% VAT on goods exported outside Bangladesh
zero_rating.deemed_exports: 0% VAT on supplies against foreign currency
zero_rating.international_tenders: 0% VAT on supplies under international tenders

input_tax_credit.full_credit: 100% input tax credit available for export-oriented production
input_tax_credit.refund: Excess input tax refundable for exporters

foreign_exchange_loss.condition: Actual loss on export proceeds realization

bonded_warehouse.benefit: Duty-free import of raw materials for export production

financial_services_sector.definition: ব্যাংক, বীমা কোম্পানী বা অনুরূপ আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান

expense_deductions.interest_paid: Fully deductible on deposits and borrowings
expense_deductions.provision_expenses: Deductible as per central bank guidelines

leasing_companies.finance_lease: Treated as loan for tax purposes

nbfi.provision_requirements: As per Financial Institutions Division rules

tds_obligations.withholding_entity: All financial institutions are TDS deducting entities
tds_obligations.deposit_interest: 10% TDS on interest payments above threshold
tds_obligations.loan_interest: Various rates based on borrower type

real_estate_sector.definition: রিয়েল এস্টেট বা ভূমি উন্নয়ন (ল্যান্ড ডেভেলপমেন্ট) ব্যবসার সহিত জড়িত

land_owner_payments.description: 15% TDS on payments to land owners
land_owner_payments.scope: সাইনিং মানি, পণমূল্য (subsistence money), বাড়ির ভাড়া বা অন্য কোনো অর্থ

registration_requirements.condition: নির্ধারিত হারে কর প্রদান না করা পর্যন্ত দলিল নিবন্ধন হবে না

urban_areas.dhaka_specific: তেজগাঁও শিল্পাঞ্চল থানা সহ ১৩টি থানার অন্তর্গত সকল মৌজা

property_transfer_tax.registration_mandatory: All property transfers must be registered

construction_materials.credit_purchases: Special provision for non-real estate taxpayers

non_real_estate_taxpayers.construction_materials: যেইক্ষেত্রে রিয়েল এস্টেট ব্যবসায় জড়িত নহে এইরূপ কোনো করদাতা
non_real_estate_taxpayers.payment_period: 2 years to pay for materials purchased on credit
non_real_estate_taxpayers.deemed_income: Unpaid amounts treated as 'other income' after 2 years

rates.manufacturing_benefit: 0.1% for first 3 years of new industries

advance_tax.rates: Sector-specific rates for different business types

bank_transfer_compliance.requirement: All business expenses above threshold through banking channels
bank_transfer_compliance.benefit: Additional deduction benefits for bank transfer compliance

digital_services.registration: Foreign digital service providers must register

sme_provisions.definition: Small and Medium Enterprises with specific turnover thresholds

benefits.tax_rates: Preferential rates for certain SME categories

turnover_thresholds.minimum_tax: Various thresholds based on entity type
